observations: Photo 0 shows a beige/cream vintage-style manual sewing machine on a table/floor.
Brand/model text is visible on the front panel: “IDEAL TOPSTAR”.
There is a power cord and a foot pedal connected (seller calls it manual, but it appears electrically powered).
The machine body has visible dust/age wear and some scuffs/staining on the base and bed.
No close-up of the needle area, bobbin compartment, or stitch/working demonstration is shown.

claims.claim: Ideal Topstar manual sewing machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows “IDEAL TOPSTAR” on the machine.
Photo 0 shows a power cord and foot pedal, which suggests it may be electrically driven rather than purely manual; no clear label stating “manual” is shown.

risks.risk: Whether it actually stitches correctly (timing, tension, feed, and motor/drive condition). Photos don’t show a test run.
risks.proof: A short video of stitching on fabric (straight stitch + reverse if available) with the needle moving continuously, plus a close-up of the stitch result.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven/possibly needing service (worst case: not working or unreliable).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect accessories (bobbin, presser feet, needle, spool pin, manual/parts). Photos don’t show what’s included.
risks.proof: A clear photo of everything included laid out (bobbin(s), needles, presser feet, spool holder, power plug, any manuals) and a photo of the bobbin compartment open.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst case: buyer may need to buy missing parts).

risks.risk: Condition of needle area and feed mechanism (bent needle bar, worn feed dogs, damaged presser foot). Only general wear is visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle plate, feed dogs, presser foot underside, and the bobbin case area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/needs inspection (worst case: parts may be worn).

risks.risk: Electrical safety and pedal/motor functionality (cord damage, pedal failure).
risks.proof: Photo of the plug/cord condition and a video showing the pedal controlling speed smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as electrical function unverified (worst case: motor/pedal may be faulty).

proof_requests: Video test: stitching on fabric (straight + any available stitch mode) showing consistent feed and tension.
Close-ups: needle plate/feed dogs, bobbin compartment, presser foot and needle area.
Photos of included accessories (bobbin(s), needles, presser feet, spool pin/holders) and what exactly comes with the machine.
Video showing pedal speed control and that the machine runs smoothly.
response.reason: The brand/model “IDEAL TOPSTAR” is readable, but the key value driver—whether it works properly and what accessories are included—is not proven by the single photo. Without a stitch test and close-ups of the working parts, pricing would be guesswork.
